description: This Java class 'UtilObject' provides utility methods for object serialization, deserialization, hashing, and factory-based object creation within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilObject
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for object serialization, deserialization, hashing, and factory object retrieval.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Serializes an object to a byte array.

methods.name: getByteCount
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the serialized form of an object.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array back into an object, logging errors and returning null on failure.

methods.name: getObjectException
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into an object, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: doHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for an object, handling arrays recursively.

methods.name: getObjectFromFactory
methods.description: Uses ServiceLoader to find and instantiate an object via a factory interface based on input.
